mapper.sql: select category_id, category_name, parent_id, ancestors, order_num, status, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time from report_category
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and category_name like concat('%', #{categoryName}, '%') order by parent_id, order_num
mapper.insert: insert into report_category (category_id, category_name, parent_id, ancestors, order_num, status, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{categoryId}, #{categoryName}, #{parentId}, #{ancestors}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update report_category set del_flag = '2' where category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from report_config where category_id = #{categoryId} and del_flag = '0'
